text:
sara kim: Quick sync for Dawn Pop launch tomorrow AM. Need final hero image, two X hooks, LinkedIn post, UTMs, and who handles inbound demo asks. :sun_with_face:
leo nguyen: uploading hero 20s + two thumbnail variants now. will drop paths in a sec and include alt text. :camera_with_flash:
taylor ng: i'll draft two X hooks (speed vs cost) + a 3-tweet microthread. jade take LinkedIn longform?
jade simpson: on it. i'll use a short customer vignette and ask to register. will avoid 'link in bio' per compliance.
sara kim: UTM template: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=dawn_pop_launch&utm_content={variant} — replace {variant} with x-speed / x-savings / ln-story.
social-scheduler: queued: X 08:20 PST (hook A + hero20 + thumb-a), LinkedIn 09:00 PST (ln-story + static-thumb-b). preflight ping scheduled for 07:50 PST.
leo nguyen: uploaded to /marketing/assets/dawn-pop/ (hero20.mp4, thumb-a.jpg, thumb-b.jpg). alt text added.
taylor ng: Microthread draft:
Root: Ship LLM features without the latency tax. Dawn Pop delivers predictable latency + lower unit cost. Demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-speed
Reply1: Dashboard peek  realtime token costs + per-route SLAs.
Reply2: Autoscale story  how we maintained SLOs during a burst.
Reply3: Register for the live demo + 10-min setup guide.
jade simpson: LinkedIn draft: "Teams building with LLMs juggle latency, cost, and reliability. Dawn Pop unifies serving + observability so engineers ship confidently. Join our demo to see the dashboard and setup checklist." replaced "link in bio" with registration link.
sara kim: routing: DMs -> taylor, comment triage -> jade then community. if sales-intent tag @sara kim to create Airtable row.
jess-bot: preflight reminder will post at 07:50 PST in this thread. :robot_face:
social-scheduler: preflight completed at 07:51 PST: assets present, UTMs validated, posts scheduled.
leo nguyen: GIF for comment replies done (6s loop) and uploaded.
jade simpson: i'll post top-8 reply templates (pricing, model support, private deploys, SLA) by 08:05.
sara kim: final: A/B test headline speed vs savings (50/50). taylor label variants x-speed-A / x-savings-B in scheduler. collect engagement after 2 hours and share highlights. good run team :thumbsup:
